Senses.Note: 7 exact occurrences anchor this appraisal of an encounter between adepts across 7 independent works.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Grove of the Tradition’s Mirror: Yuanwu Keqin appraises Zhaozhou Congshen and Baizhang Huaihai as adepts meeting and says each is hard for the other to get hold of.

Occurrences.Kwic: 後聞溈山盛化。直造溈山。便作家相見。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2003.xml). Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo: Yuanwu Keqin narrates Deshan Xuanjian going directly to Guishan Lingyou and characterizes what follows as adepts meeting.

Occurrences.Kwic: 可謂作家相見。且道誰是陷虎？誰是擒龍？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB171.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Tianyin: Tianyin Yuanxiu calls Linji Yixuan and Puhua’s reciprocal meal-table encounter adepts meeting, then asks which traps the tiger and which captures the dragon.

Occurrences.Kwic: 昭覺勤云：作家相見，彼此難搆。茫然悄然，進前退後。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1296.xml). Compilation of the School Gate’s Raising Old Cases: Yuanwu Keqin again grades the Zhaozhou–Baizhang encounter, adding their advance and retreat to the appraisal.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin: Feiyin Tongrong says direct indication requires adepts meeting, with reciprocal striking and a knowing counterpart answering.

Occurrences.Kwic: 作家相見，一語便知得失，不是別有箇什麼喚做向上。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB406.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianran of Mount Lu: Tianran Hanshi says that when adepts meet, one statement discloses gain or loss; he rejects inventing something else called above-and-beyond.

Occurrences.Kwic: 二大老龍象蹴蹋誠為作家相見
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (L/L154/L154n1639.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianyin Xiu: Tianyin Yuanxiu raises Deshan Xuanjian’s arrival before Guishan Lingyou and explicitly calls the two elders’ forceful exchange adepts meeting, while still criticizing a delayed response.

Senses.Explanation: Adepts meeting names a reciprocal encounter in which the cited participants are treated as capable operators whose moves immediately expose how they answer one another. Yuanwu Keqin applies the phrase to Zhaozhou Congshen with Baizhang Huaihai and to Deshan Xuanjian arriving before Guishan Lingyou; his comments emphasize difficulty in getting hold of the other party, advance and retreat, and Guishan’s unhurried observation. Tianyin Yuanxiu uses the label for Linji Yixuan and Puhua overturning the meal table, then asks who traps the tiger and who captures the dragon. Feiyin Tongrong joins the meeting to reciprocal striking and a knowing counterpart, while Tianran Hanshi says a single statement then shows gain or loss. Tianyin Yuanxiu also applies it to Deshan Xuanjian and Guishan Lingyou while distinguishing the encounter itself from a response he judges too late. The expression is an appraisal made by the cited commentator; two masters merely occupying one narrative do not thereby become adepts meeting.
